0022600150.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-5, on a five-game losing streak) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (5-0, on a five-game winning streak) for the sixth game of the Kings' season, and the Kings are 0-3 on the road while Memphis is 1-0 at home. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while Memphis is missing nothing certain but has Quinten Post as a day-to-day game-time decision with an ankle issue. The Kings trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1, having lost 123-112 in Sacramento on October 25, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
